headline: Dangote Fuel Exports Exceed Domestic Supply at 54.63 Million Litres Daily
summary: Exports of petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel from the Dangote Petroleum Refinery hit 54.63 million litres per day in September 2026, surpassing domestic receipts.
why: The Dangote Refinery is a massive mega-refinery project intended to reshape fuel supply dynamics across West Africa and international product trade.

impacts.name: Refined Petroleum Products
impacts.why: Export output volume exceeded domestic fuel receipts.
